record.overall: The logbook provides numerical sanity checks of the paper's theoretical results on 1D, small-grid, simple-quadratic proxy setups, and defers the only large-scale experimental claim (multi-item auctions, Table I). No claim is verified at the paper's real scale or generality; all addressed claims are toy-level demonstrations.
record.paper_title: Universal Representation of Generalized Convex Functions and their Gradients
